item_short_desc: Designed to keep vital extremities warm in the most extreme cold weather, Rothco’s Polar Fleece Balaclava provides comprehensive protection for your head, face, and neck. The lightweight polar fleece material effectively retains heat, ensuring your neck and face remain warm while traveling through harsh environments. With full thermal coverage, this balaclava can be tucked into jackets for added protection against the cold.
description: Designed to keep vital extremities warm in the most extreme cold weather, Rothco’s Polar Fleece Balaclava provides comprehensive protection for your head, face, and neck. The lightweight polar fleece material effectively retains heat, ensuring your neck and face remain warm while traveling through harsh environments. With full thermal coverage, this balaclava can be tucked into jackets for added protection against the cold. Its one-size-fits-most design makes it ideal for a variety of outdoor activities such as camping, skiing, hiking, and more. Rothco’s Polar Fleece Balaclava is an essential accessory for anyone braving cold weather conditions, combining warmth, comfort, and versatility. Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions. Whether you’re tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas, or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, our diverse range of headwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from active-duty personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
